official.deadline_note: TSLS publishes no closing date on the scheme page. The TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook states that all applications must be successfully submitted before the application closing date and that late and incomplete applications will not be considered for assessment, so the closing date is announced through the TSLS Apply portal.
official.application_cycle: 2026-2027 Financial Year (TSLS 2027 Scholarship Policies Handbook, published September 2026)
official.status_note: The scheme is listed in TSLS's 2027 Scholarship Policies Handbook for the 2026-2027 Financial Year with 5 awards, and the scheme page carries a live 'Apply Now' button to the TSLS Apply portal. No closing date is published on the scheme page.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The 2027 TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook executive summary describes the scheme as: "This existing scheme is being revamped to partially support students except the Tuition Fee, which partner Universities in Australia and New Zealand shall bear." Tuition is therefore not among TSLS's own listed payments for this scheme; it is borne by the partner university.
benefits: Living allowance at a minimum AUD/NZD of $32,000 or at a local market rate
Overseas student health cover fee for sponsored students only
Establishment allowance, a one-off payment at the beginning of the programme, at a maximum rate of AUD/NZD $3500

Excess baggage allowance at a maximum rate of AUD/NZD $300, and a field grant of up to AUD/NZD $3,000 only if the student is required and approved to undertake field surveys for primary data collection
eligibility: Be ordinarily a resident of Fiji for at least three (3) years before the award commencement date unless determined by the Service
Secure an offer letter or candidature confirmation letter from an eligible institution in Australia or New Zealand for full-time studies unless determined by the Service or arranged with the employer
Demonstrate the direct and applied relevance of the research study towards Fiji's workforce needs and development
Be less than 50 years of age from the time of application
Not be an existing TSLS sponsored student or graduate (on active bond service) or sponsored through any other agency
requirements: Register on TSLS Apply, complete the online form and submit the application
Hold an offer letter or candidature confirmation letter from one of the eligible institutions
Enrol in the full academic load of the sponsored programme required under the academic regulations of the tertiary education institution
Satisfy the yearly progressive report, which is the review requirement TSLS applies to this scheme
Accept the bond on the TSLS online application system, since confirmation of sponsorship is subject to accepting the Offer Letter and Acceptance Agreement and the Bond
documents: Tertiary Education Institute offer letter or candidature confirmation letter
Tax Identification Number, digital passport photo and birth certificate
Bank, Mpaisa or MyCash statement (where applicable)
Parents pay slip or statutory declaration
Medical report (where applicable), with parental death certificate, letter of guardianship or care home confirmation where applicable
selection_criteria: Research must fall within one of twelve priority disciplines: Medical and Health Services, Engineering Services, Climate Change/Environmental Science, Marine Science, Forestry, Public Policy and Analysis, Economic Modelling and Policies, Public Financing, Inclusive Education, Information Technology Services, Social Science and Border Security
The research study must demonstrate direct and applied relevance towards Fiji's workforce needs and development
Only 5 awards are available under the scheme for the 2026-2027 Financial Year

Eligible institutions are limited to ten Australian universities: CQ University Australia, Griffith University, Monash University, Queensland University of Technology, Swinburne University of Technology, University of Newcastle, University of New South Wales, University of Queensland, Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology University and Western Sydney University
coverage: Living allowance at a minimum AUD/NZD of $32,000 or at a local market rate
Visa fees up to $3000 FJD and the overseas student health cover fee for sponsored students
Establishment allowance of up to AUD/NZD $3500 one-off at the beginning of the programme, and excess baggage allowance of up to AUD/NZD $300
Field grant of up to AUD/NZD $3,000 for approved primary data collection field surveys
Tuition fee, which the partner university in Australia or New Zealand bears rather than TSLS
application_method: Visit tsls.com.fj and click Apply Online, then Register to create a TSLS Apply account using your own valid email address (Gmail, Yahoo or Hotmail)
Log in, update your personal details under My Account, then select the eligible scheme under View Programs and click Apply
Complete each task, uploading the required documents in pdf, png or jpg format, and click Mark as Complete to move to the next task
Accept the Declaration to submit the application, then track status and progress under My Application
official.application_route: Online through the TSLS Apply portal, which the scheme page links to directly as 'Apply Now'; TSLS processes the application and issues the scholarship result.
official.citizenship_residency: Fiji citizens ordinarily resident in Fiji for at least three years before the award commencement date, unless determined by the Service
official.international_eligibility: No - open only to Fiji citizens, though the study itself must be undertaken at an eligible university in Australia or New Zealand
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The research must fall within one of the twelve listed priority disciplines and must demonstrate direct and applied relevance towards Fiji's workforce needs and development; eligible institutions are the ten listed Australian universities
official.research_requirement: Applicants must demonstrate the direct and applied relevance of the research study towards Fiji's workforce needs and development, and must secure an offer letter or candidature confirmation letter from an eligible institution; the academic review requirement for this scheme is a yearly progressive report
official.duration: Not published on the scheme page; sponsorship duration is covered in the TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook, and students who fail to complete within the stated duration may apply for an extension of sponsorship
official.description: The Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scheme is a TSLS scholarship, revamped to partially support Fiji citizens undertaking full-time PhD study at ten eligible universities in Australia. Under the cost-sharing arrangement the tuition fee is borne by the partner university in Australia or New Zealand, while TSLS provides a living allowance, airfare, visa and health cover support and other allowances. Five awards are available for the 2026-2027 Financial Year.
official.program_type: Government scholarship (Fiji Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service statutory scheme, cost-sharing)

not_confirmed: the tuition amount borne by the partner university
the exact published duration of the sponsorship
verification.notes: The living allowance figure and the benefit schedule were read from section 1.4 Scholarship Schemes Privileges of the official 2027 TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook, the cost-sharing tuition arrangement from its section 1.0 Executive Summary, and eligibility, priority disciplines and institutions from section 1.2.1 and the live scheme page, which confirms 5 awards. The living allowance is published as a minimum of AUD/NZD $32,000 or at a local market rate, so the same figure applies in either currency. No closing date is published.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a five-award scheme for the 2026-2027 financial year, so it is one of the most competitive overseas routes TSLS runs, and its defining feature is the cost-sharing model. TSLS pays you - a minimum living allowance of AUD/NZD 32,000 a year, economy return airfare, visa fees up to FJD 3,000, overseas student health cover, an establishment allowance of up to AUD/NZD 3,500 and a field grant of up to AUD/NZD 3,000 for approved primary data collection - while the partner university bears the tuition fee. That division of labour is the single most important thing to understand before you apply: your financial future depends on a university tuition arrangement that sits outside the TSLS award. You also need to be under 50, a Fiji citizen with three years ordinary residence, and hold an offer or candidature from one of only ten named Australian universities, with research framed around Fiji's workforce and development needs.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Fiji citizens under 50 with a full-time PhD offer or candidature from one of the ten listed Australian universities, whose research demonstrably serves Fiji's workforce or development needs in a priority discipline.
application_readiness_checklist: Get the candidature or offer letter first - the scheme requires an offer letter or candidature confirmation letter from an eligible institution, and there are only ten eligible universities
Before applying, get written confirmation from the university of exactly what tuition support it will provide, since the cost-sharing model puts tuition with the university rather than with TSLS
Frame your research explicitly around Fiji's workforce needs and development, naming the discipline gap it fills and how you will return that capacity to Fiji
Check your age against the under-50 rule at the time of application, and confirm your three years ordinary residence in Fiji before the award commencement date

Assemble the standard TSLS document set as pdf, png or jpg scans: offer letter, highest qualification result, Tax Identification Number, digital passport photo, birth certificate, and bank or mobile wallet statement where applicable
Register on the TSLS Apply portal with your own Gmail, Yahoo or Hotmail address and verify the account before you start the form
common_rejection_risks: Assuming TSLS pays the tuition fee, then discovering the university's share is less than expected or not formalised

Applying with only five available awards against a field that includes all twelve priority disciplines, so a research proposal that does not clearly serve Fiji's workforce needs will not survive the cut
Holding an offer from a university outside the ten eligible Australian institutions, or from a New Zealand institution when the handbook and scheme page name Australian universities
Being 50 or older at the time of application
Being an existing TSLS sponsored student, a graduate on active bond service, or already sponsored through another agency
Arranging part-time study or employer-based study without the Service's determination, since the eligibility requires full-time studies unless determined otherwise
Submitting late or incomplete applications, which TSLS states will not be considered for assessment
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: TSLS's published privileges are generous, but they are minima rather than guarantees: the living allowance is a minimum of AUD/NZD 32,000 or at a local market rate, the establishment allowance is capped at AUD/NZD 3,500, the field grant is capped at AUD/NZD 3,000 and only paid if field surveys for primary data collection are required and approved, and the excess baggage allowance is capped at AUD/NZD 300. Your tuition is wholly dependent on the partner university's own arrangement, which TSLS does not quantify. Anything beyond those caps, and any living cost above the local market rate, is yours to cover.
document_audit: The offer letter or candidature confirmation letter must come from one of the ten eligible universities; check the list before you apply anywhere else

TSLS asks for final results rather than annual results, and uploads must be pdf, png or jpg - the Know How To Apply page states file size should not exceed 5MB, while the handbook states 20MB, so keep files small and test the upload
A Tax Identification Number and birth certificate are part of the standard document set and are easy to overlook if you have never needed them
Bank, Mpaisa or MyCash statements are requested where applicable, so have current statements ready
Confirmation of sponsorship depends on accepting the Offer Letter and Acceptance Agreement and accepting the Bond on the portal, so do not treat submission as acceptance
alerts: Only 5 awards are available under the scheme for the 2026-2027 Financial Year
Tuition is borne by the partner university, not TSLS - secure that arrangement in writing before you rely on this scholarship
An awardee, upon successful completion, must comply with the conditions set in the bond agreement to serve the country, and TSLS runs a Travel and Bond Clearance and Repayment portal to administer it
No student is allowed to work full-time or part-time unless approved by TSLS or as per scheme requirements, so you must live within the allowance
The review requirement for this scheme is a yearly progressive report, not a GPA threshold, but failure to meet requirements leads to probation and then suspension with all payments ceased
No application closing date is published on the scheme page, so monitor the portal and TSLS channels rather than assuming a fixed window
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the TSLS Apply portal, select the Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scheme under View Programs, complete each task with your offer letter and academic documents, accept the declaration and submit, then track the application under My Application; once awarded, accept the offer letter and bond on the portal for sponsorship to be confirmed.
